'''''Motti''''' was a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] destroyed during an attack on an Imperial Storage Area in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan D1 Sector]] as part of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Operation Grain Snatch|plan]] to discredit [[Overlord (Imperial)|Overlord]] [[Ghorin]].
